data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 6.543 million, representing a 7.28% reduction in opening gross reserves. This favourable development is supported by the 2019 year of account closing with a profit of GBP 0.7 million and a profit release of GBP 15.7 million approved for the 2020 year of account. Prior years were impacted by events such as the COVID-19 pandemic, Hurricanes Sally, Laura, and Zeta in 2020, and the Texas winter freeze in 2021 affecting the 2020 YOA.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is based on the gross movement in claims and loss adjustment expenses from Note 12. The claims development triangle shows a different, smaller strengthening for prior years, but the direct movement note is prioritized. Narrative mentions profit releases for 2019 and 2020 YOAs, which are net figures and consistent with an overall gross release.
